name: 2026-11-18-library-proof
facts: Tulvo puts clients, projects and invoices in one workspace (save-the-date film, 14 Nov 2026).
Describe your business and Tulvo builds it (save-the-date film, 14 Nov 2026).
notes: The library's proof film (LIBRARY-PLAN phase 6): the same 15 s Tulvo film made twice. New: a library hook opener, six new text moves, three new transitions and a hard cut on a downbeat, library sounds, cuts on the beats of a bundled bed. Old: the kit as it was before the library, the brand's own eleven sounds, cuts set by eye. Same words, same bed.
No voice: every line is on screen, so the film is silent-first. lines.json gives when each line is on screen, so the beat sheet reads real times.
Not a delivery: it is a test of the library for the owner to compare. Rule 19 (sound and music only from ElevenLabs) is superseded for this test by the approved LIBRARY-PLAN; see compare.md.
